note: Code-rendered video templates (research; not in the plugin yet). Each card is an archetype seen in the Opus 5.5 video prompts, rewritten from scratch as our own brief (the source prompts are behavioral references only: see ../INDEX.md). `prompt` is what Claude follows to make a new version: it writes a page on runtime/mdna.js with VARS for the content, renders it with html_to_mp4.py and brings the file into AE with add_asset (route A), rebuilds it from Motion DNA presets (route B) or does both (route C: plate rendered with --notext, text and UI live in AE). Energy 1 calm .. 5 explosive, as in library/tags.json.

fields.route: A render to MP4/MOV · B native AE · C hybrid

templates.title: Showreel on the beat

vars.bpm: tempo; every cut lands on a beat
vars.words: three short words for the kinetic beat
vars.title: end title

templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s motion-design showreel at {bpm} BPM: 6-7 scenes, each one formal idea (bars sweeping, a breathing dot grid, a kinetic word swap, one shape morphing, a particle burst settling into a ring, a chart drawing itself), every cut on a beat with a one-frame accent flash, ending on a serif title card. Use only Motion DNA colours, fonts and curves; no logos.

templates.title: SaaS launch
templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s launch film for {app} (fictional): a three-line hook, then its dashboard assembles card by card (a chart, a counting balance, a list, a progress bar) while a cursor taps the key element; three feature pills land one per beat; a quick whip-zoom into the product, then an end card with a simple mark, the name and a CTA. Draw the UI as shapes (no screenshots). Support ?notext so the plate can go under live AE text.

templates.title: One shape becomes the UI
templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s UI film where one shape is never cut: it morphs by size, radius and colour into a button, a toggle, a slider, a stats card and a progress ring that ends in a check. A cursor drives every change with clicks and drags; content swaps with a short blur and separate enter/exit timing. Each state is a key of one shape (so it can be rebuilt as one AE shape layer).

templates.title: Infinite zoom
templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s single continuous camera where every change of scale is a match: open already moving on a live data point and pull out to a finished product desktop (charts with area fills and labels, positions, watchlist, orders) that keeps living for a beat; pull out until the desktop is a glowing point among world-space stars at several depths (streaks, real parallax); dive back in so the point becomes a portrait phone screen with the same product re-laid for mobile; end on a slow tilt with a serif-accent line. Text that the camera crosses fades near the edges; finish() grain and vignette.

templates.title: Kinetic typography

vars.lines: lines of words; *word* marks the key word (spark, pops)

templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s kinetic-typography overlay on transparency: a manifesto read word by word, one line per shot, words rising into a mask on Land, the key word of each line in spark with a Pop, a one-word line set huge with an underline sweep, every line leaving with Launch. Rebuild natively with Motion DNA text presets when the text must stay editable.

templates.title: Storybook explainer
templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s explainer told by a character with a personality (eyes, blinks, moods) across three worlds stacked like a camera tilting down (space, weather, ground), each handed over by a cloud bank the character dives through. One idea per world, with an on-screen counter the action really drives (each dodged drop ticks it), a payoff where something lights up from where the character lands, serif captions on a pill, token palette only. Captions off with ?notext.

templates.title: Timeline explainer

vars.title: headline
vars.items: [year, title, icon] milestones (icon: dot, square, people, star, globe)

templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s timeline: a line draws with the playhead (a spark ring), cards pop above and below per milestone with an illustration in a fixed slot, a year odometer rolls behind, the camera follows the playhead smoothly and cards fade before the frame edge; end by pulling back so the last chapters stay readable, bring the title back with its serif accent and keep a slow drift. Light paper (cloud) with the light finish.

templates.title: Data story

vars.groups: [label, count] bars the same dots regroup into

templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s data story about one number: 100 dots fall into a 10x10 waffle, the {share} that matter light up in spark one by one, the same dots regroup into labelled bars, then the headline percentage counts up and a last sentence lands. Every mark is a dot you can count; sentences off with ?notext.

templates.title: Particle world
templates.prompt: Make a seamless {duration}s loop of a 3D place drawn with thousands of glowing specks (no solid fills): rolling waves of particles, a sun made of particles, a slow camera sway, the light going from day to dusk and back so the loop closes. Project the points by hand on a 2D canvas (no libraries).

templates.title: Shader hero object

vars.colours: pine / sea / spark / cloud in the shader

templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s hero product plate as one fragment shader: a ray-marched glossy object (a torus that breathes into a capsule) on a studio floor with soft shadow, spark rim light, slow turntable and push-in. The shader reads only uTime so every frame renders the same.

templates.title: Liquid wipe
templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s transition overlay on transparency: a spark leading edge and a pine body sweep across with wobbling noisy fronts (Whip), fully cover the frame at the midpoint (cut the shots there), then uncover with the spark trailing (Surge).

templates.title: Logo reveal

vars.name: wordmark (fictional)
vars.mark: three colours for disc, bar, arc

templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s logo reveal on transparency for a fictional mark built from three primitives (disc, bar, arc): each part flies in on its own curve (Wind-up, Whip, Settle), they lock with a Pop, the mark slides left, the wordmark types on letter by letter and the tagline settles. Never use a real brand's logo.

templates.title: Install tutorial (app walkthrough)

vars.app: the app window being walked through (fictional or our own UI)

templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s step-by-step install tutorial on a pine gradient wallpaper: one flat dark window style for every app, a cursor that clicks through each step while the camera pushes in on what is clicked (so UI text reads at 24 px or more), a step card (STEP n OF 7, title, one line) with callouts in its own column, a progress bar in its own band, and clean dissolves between worlds; each step lands on its voice line, with gaps left for presenter clips between steps.

templates.title: Pixel character (documented rig)
inspired_by: ClaudeAnimationBase (MIT): a rig with views, emotions and an acted mood change

vars.character: slug of a character with a pixel style

templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s pixel-art short where a documented character acts one beat: it rolls in, looks around, reads an order, reacts (squash, hop, land) as its screen swaps emotion, waves and celebrates; poses on twos, the eyes lead the body, the world at 240x135 scaled x8, Motion DNA type on top. The character is drawn from its character.json by runtime/pixel_rig.js; ?sheet renders its character sheet from the same file.

templates.title: The Agent explains (promo + capsules)
inspired_by: prompt-motion product-film recipe: one through-line, a beat grid

vars.?only=<scene>: render one scene alone as a capsule

templates.prompt: Make a {duration}s announcement where a documented character presents what is new, one short scene per feature, each cut on the beat of the music bed (scene lengths in beats): a hook, each feature acted by the character with Motion DNA UI beside it (pills, cards, counters, a terminal line, the panel's button), then how to get it. Each scene also renders alone as a capsule (?only=<scene>). Finish in AE: the silent render, a CC0 music bed and sound effects on the cues, master at -14 LUFS.

templates.title: Social carousel (11 styles)
inspired_by: Swiper effects (coverflow, cube, cards, flip, creative; MIT)

vars.style: coverflow | cube | cylinder | stack | flip | panorama | orbit | fan | strip | swipe | depth

templates.prompt: Make a 4:5 social carousel post that moves between five slides in one carousel style: each step eases on a token curve and holds long enough to read, pager dots track the slide, a finger shows the swipe where it helps; real 3D perspective (CSS 3D), photos never stretched.

templates.title: The Agent eats a repo (pixel GIF)

vars.character: a character in library/characters with a pixel style

templates.prompt: Make a square looping pixel GIF: the character rolls in next to a big code document, its eyes light up, it turns toward it and lunges with its whole screen gaping (the body balloons), bites it, chews, rubs its belly, rolls away and the line lands big in the centre; empty stage at both ends so the loop never shows. ?mark=github only for internal use.

templates.title: Hop steps (process in 9:16)
inspired_by: claude-animation-skills, minimalistic-graphics (MIT, 5dbea55): squash and stretch numbers
templates.prompt: Make a minimal 9:16 graphic of a process in a few steps: a dot pops in on the first step and hops to each next one with squash and stretch, each landing lights its step and writes its label, the last step gets a ring and sparks, then the payoff line lands; text inside the reel safe area and a slow drift so nothing freezes.

templates.title: Map route (A to B in 9:16)
inspired_by: claude-animation-skills, map-route (MIT, 5dbea55): route draw timing, camera trailing ~2%, pin fall/bounce/squash numbers, ETA tied to progress

vars.from, to: start and destination labels (fictional names, ~20 characters max for the destination)
vars.mode: walk | bike | drive (sets the distance: 12, 4 or 2 min per km)
vars.minutes: trip time; the ETA counts down from it

templates.prompt: Make a 9:16 graphic of a trip on a stylised 2D map drawn in code (street grid, blocks, parks, a canal, fictional names, our palette): a route draws from A to B with an in-out curve while the camera rides slightly behind its head, then pulls back to show the whole route; a pin drops on the destination with one bounce and a squash and its name lands above it; an ETA card counts the minutes down with the route and ends on Arrived; text inside the reel safe area and a slow drift so nothing freezes.

templates.title: Exploded view (layers and labels in 9:16)
inspired_by: claude-animation-skills, breakdown (MIT, 5dbea55): layer order, lift stagger and leader/label timings

vars.layers: 4 or 5 short labels, top layer first

templates.prompt: Make a 9:16 exploded view of a fictional device built from flat layers in a 2.5D isometric view: the stack appears assembled, the layers lift apart top first with a short stagger while it turns slowly with a small wobble, then thin leader lines with one bend draw out to a numbered label column on the right and each label slides in and fades; text inside the reel safe area, labels well apart, and the stack keeps turning so the end never freezes.

templates.title: Line tip number (one stat in 9:16)
inspired_by: claude-animation-skills, graph (MIT, 5dbea55): timings, the count under the tip, halo and drop line

vars.unit: the plain noun under the number (e.g. paying teams)
vars.points: 2 to ~14 values, oldest first, 0 or above
vars.labels: one x label per point (more than 8: every other one shows)

templates.prompt: Make a minimal 9:16 stat graphic with one line and one big number: gridlines draw in from the left, axis labels fade in staggered, then a smoothed line draws left to right while the number above shows the value under the line's moving tip and lands exactly on the last point; on landing the number turns spark, a halo grows around the end point and a dashed drop line falls to the axis; the digits roll (never a one-frame swap), text stays in the reel safe area and a slow drift with a breathing halo keeps the end alive.
